name: CASC-29
description: The CADE ATP System Competition (CASC) is the annual evaluation of fully automatic, classical logic, Automated Theorem Proving (ATP) systems – the world championship for such systems. CASC-29 was the twenty-eighth competition in the CASC series. Twenty-four ATP systems competed in the various divisions. This paper presents an outline of the competition design and a commentated summary of the results.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on classical ATP systems; specialized problem sets and engineering-heavy systems—results not directly comparable to neural LLMs.
